metadata.title: One-dimensional Dirichlet forms with prescribed Hölder regularity
metadata.abstract: We study a class of strongly local, regular Dirichlet forms on the standard unit interval. The aim of our work is to record some Hölder regularity properties that have not been noted in the prior literature. In particular, as our main result, we show that for every $\delta \in (0,1]$ there exists a metric measure space $(X,d,\mu)$ equipped with a strongly local, regular Dirichlet form $(\mathcal{E},\mathcal{F})$ on $L^2(\mu)$ with the property that $\delta$ is the supremum of $\alpha \in (0,1]$ for which the domain $\mathcal{F}$ of the Dirichlet form contains a non-constant $\alpha$-Hölder continuous function. To the best of our knowledge, such examples were previously known only for $\delta = 1$. In our construction, the value $\delta$ is characterized by the upper Hausdorff dimension of a certain Radon measure that is used to define $(\mathcal{E},\mathcal{F})$.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对每个 δ∈(0,1] 构造带强局部正则 Dirichlet 型的度量测度空间，使其定义域内非恒定 Hölder 函数可达指数的上确界正好为 δ。
analysis.breakthrough: 将已知 δ=1 的现象扩展为可连续指定的 Hölder 正则阈值。
analysis.limitations: 上确界为 δ 不自动说明端点指数一定可达；构造的度量和测度依赖也需区分。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 是分析结构与度量正则性之间的具体分离例子，可用于检验一般正则性猜测。
